profile.headline: Freelance Multimedia Advertiser
profile.summary: I specialize in all forms of Multimedia Advertising which includes Brand Packaging, Social Media Promotion, Video & Motion Graphic Content, as well as even basic Tshirt Designs & Business Card Designs with a quick turn around.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Work closely with the Operations Team to help manage the National Wrestling Alliance Website, as well as their online merchandise shop. I have been assisting the social media team with creating schedules for content for the week, as well as creating content.

positions.title: Social Media Director
positions.description: Working Side by Side with the internal team to create digital and printable graphical assets for the company.

positions.title: Creative Director
positions.description:
Help Businesses all over the United States and outside as well, create different types of Digital Advertising so they can make themselves known in the market 

I have also helped with Social Media Marketing on all platforms and scheduling out content while also paying attention to high-traffic times for posting so that it can reach your target audience.

positions.title: Freelance Graphic Designer
positions.description: I am currently one of the freelance graphic artists that work with Aeonian Legacy Management & Consulting. I work with them on a project to project basis as well as learn from them to gain better business knowledge of the industry as a whole.

company.name: Aeonian Legacy Management And Consulting Group

positions.title: Video Production Engineer
positions.description: In charge of running Livestream Conferences for different companies throughout the world. Also in charge of making sure the production of the Livestream throughout it's entirety is done properly as well as using the companies confer moderate system to control the status of the livestream as well as communicate with the video operator

positions.title: Freelancer
positions.description: I currently work under Robert Half as a Freelancer, they send me different contracts within the Columbus, Ohio area that vary within my field of work.

positions.title: Marketing Coordinator
positions.description: I am in charge of maintaining all marketing content needed for the company whether digital or print material. I also assist with planning an in office events or networking events being held by the firm.

positions.title: Crew Member
positions.description: Assist in the Day to Day operations for the Einsteins Bagel location Maitland, FL

positions.title: In-House Graphic Designer
positions.description: In charge of creating all marketing content for the company as well design templates to be used by the owner & creating media content of the homes.

positions.title: Graphic Design Intern
positions.description:
Creating Social Media Content & Website Banners alongside any other graphical content needed. 

Also assist with Website Maintenance and any projects that the Lead Designer would need assistance on

positions.title: Multimedia Specialist
positions.description:
Currently the Project Manager at CDI. I have helped complete several jobs related to print and currently learning project management skills & beginning to learn about 3D, Vinyl/ and Custom Print Design

I have also have assisted with creating a proper file structure for the production team & assist with Account Management and Customer Management alongside the Operations Manager & Creative Director

positions.title: Sign Spinner
positions.description: got the chance to sign spin for different Real Estate/Businesses all across Central Florida

positions.title: Art Director
positions.description: Helped develop company brand guide as well as help with workflow on 360 Virtual Tours & Assist with file structure & editing of drone footage

honors.title: Perfect Attendance Award
honors.description: Did not miss one Lab/Lecture during my entire time at Full Sail University
honors.issuer: Issued by Full Sail University · Mar 2016

projects.title: Cantor Granite Brand Identity
projects.description: I was tasked by Cantor Granite to create an entire brand identity to help convey to there audience what services they offer. I am continuing to work alongside them on Promotional Campaigns and am very excited to continue on with them!

projects.title: Lucy Juicy Brand Identity
